brief: A 3D, kinetic front end for any knowledge graph, used by developers and by AI coding agents. It should feel kinetic, luminous, connected and precise, without brains, sparkles or the generic three-dot share icon.
criteria: Success: says 3D graph at a glance, distinct from network clichés, readable at 16 px with the small cut, works in one colour and reversed.

concepts.name: Depth
concepts.idea: A four-node pyramid graph whose back link breaks where it passes behind the front one, so it reads in 3D; the front node is the one in focus.
rationale: Only mark in the category that shows a graph in space rather than on a flat page
The coloured front node mirrors the app's focus/selection state
Small-size cut drops the back link and thickens strokes for 16 px

recommendation: Depth: say "3D knowledge graph" in one shape, with the focus node as the brand accent.
next_steps: Use the horizontal lockup in the README and app header
Ship the web icon set as the app favicon
Run a trademark search before any public launch
